snippet.title: Few Shall Return - Trailer
snippet.description:
Enter a dungeon in which it's guaranteed not everyone survives. Work with others on solving challenges, but escape alone. Risk whatever you bring in with you, and keep everything that you can carry... if you survive. Short rounds (10-15min). Full multiplayer RPG experience.

Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3377400/Few_Shall_Return

---

Audio credits: Black Thorns by Jimena Contreras
